scope: 17 marker fixtures and 20 callback fixtures, each case run with fresh caches
semantic_models: No third-party semantic models required; run with BIFROST_OPEN_PACKS_DISABLE=1 and isolated caches
coverage_limits: Marker impl enumeration is same-file only
Dominance proves ordering, not absence of repair or unsafe state
An empty incomplete result is not a clean result
Unqualified imported pointer APIs are not matched (#6247)
Static generic messages require reviewing the anchored impl header
Qualified API names can identify user-defined modules with the same spelling
Sync rows with shared_access=none are excluded; unavailable method access stays conservative
Shared methods include cross-file inherent and trait impl methods through the #6457 resolved-owner language hook

required_capabilities.note: Bifrost 0.15.0 does not advertise rust-marker-impls-of, call-shape-callee-provenance, call-results or control-relations-dominance, and a release requiring an unadvertised capability is rejected at admission. The manifest declares the advertised capabilities that existing policies use for the same operators; restore the precise names once a pinned engine profile lists them.

versioning: bifrost.security 2.0.0 -> 2.1.0 for two compatible opt-in policy additions. No stream release version or tag is selected here.
identity_verification: Both policies checked through the 0.15.0 policy-source-identity command; the fixture gate checks runtime and finding policy hashes against the manifest.

previous_qualification.note: Local integration build of bifrost-dev#6457 for #6385/#6394. Every case keeps its expected finding count on 0.15.0.
